# Jonathan Tubay

> Shopify and WordPress developer and automation builder based in Manila, Philippines. 12+ years of experience. Technology Lead at SentryX, and available for freelance projects.

## What I build
- Shopify stores: custom themes, app integrations, catalog, payments and checkout setup, post-launch support
- WordPress and WooCommerce sites: new builds and CMS migrations, ACF/Gutenberg, mobile-first and SEO-ready
- Softr apps on Airtable: client portals, internal dashboards, role-based access
- Workflow automation: Zapier, n8n and custom code (inventory syncs such as Cin7 to Shopify, reports, alerts)
- Figma-to-production front-end builds

## Selected work
- MOEV Solutions: freelance website build (case study linked below)
- Deirdre P. Malcolm: freelance website build
- Toolmart Houston: Shopify store and Cin7-to-Shopify inventory and price automation
- Kingdomland Kids: Shopify store work
- Sapmok USA: Shopify store revamp
- Internal tools: KDL Video Health Checker, daily report generators, service and project health dashboards, E.D.I.T.H. and T.H.O.R. assistants
